The DeepBass powered WHS-200 and WHS-600 products are completed and manufacturing-ready for Q1 2012. The WHS-200 is an open architecture in-ear headphone designed for all mobile entertainment needs. It delivers a wide spectral range of audio for music, videos, games and more. The WHS-600 is a sealed in-ear headphone designed for the ultimate in low frequency performance without sacrificing the detail of high notes. Its premium sound is ideal for demanding musical genres and movies with heavy, impactful bass.

Over 1/3 of US adults use a smartphone and more than 10% own a tablet (Pew research, May 2011). This mobile device pervasiveness combined with the domination of game and music apps as top downloads have created a growing consumer need for high quality portable audio. AAC ID8 can help OEMs better serve their customers with these standard products and customized solutions.

The DeepBass 14.2mm driver was generated through the deep R&D capabilities of AAC Technologies, which is a leading supplier of microacoustic components. Remarkable for a driver of this nature is the low levels of THD as well as its high signal sensitivity. The strength in microacoustic component development and excellence in manufacturing for scale make AAC ID8 Accessories Division an immediate leader in mobile headset development for OEMs.

Both of these headphones also feature AAC ID8's exclusive Bassport technology. The Bassport design is unique to AAC ID8 and performs as a subwoofer does to enhance low-end sound. The combination of the DeepBass 14.2mm driver with low THD and high sensitivity paired with the Bassport architecture creates a quality of sound not found in OEM offerings.
